questions.q_en: Find the angle between the hands of the clock when the time is 9:33.
questions.solution_en:
The angle between the hour hand and minute hand can be calculated using the formula -

Angle = |(60H - 11M)/2|

Where, H = Hour and M = Minutes

Here H = 9 and M = 49

Angle = |(60 X 9 - 11 X 33)/2|

= |(540 - 363)/2|

= |(177)/2|

= |88.5|

Angle = 88.5°
